summary: Andalusian Credit Company, LLC filed an 8-K reporting that its special purpose subsidiary ACC Financing SPV I, LLC amended its GS Credit Facility on November 2, 2026. The First Amendment raises the maximum facility amount from $200 million to $375 million before January 31, 2027, rising to $450 million thereafter subject to compliance conditions, and extends the reinvestment period to November 2, 2029 and maturity to November 2, 2031. Goldman Sachs entities serve as administrative, syndication and calculation agents; Computershare is collateral agent and custodian. This is a routine credit-facility upsize, not a special situation.
